{"subject":"Quick hello from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

It's been a while since we last spoke, and I wanted to check in and see how things are going at Pinecone. I'd love to hear what the team has been focused on and what's ahead for you.

If it's useful, I'm happy to set up a 20-minute call whenever suits you. No agenda, just a chance to catch up and hear how I might be helpful.

Hope all is well.

Daniel"}
